cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4M_Gyroscope_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

R4M_Gyroscope_Yoke.mount_port: R4 Robocraft-style port: 0.509 m square, outer face +0.260 m (block face), face-centre coupling
R4M_Gyroscope_Yoke.role: static U-yoke hanging from the round top mount

R4M_Gyroscope_OuterRing.role: outer gimbal ring: rotates about local X (file X)

R4M_Gyroscope_InnerRing.role: inner gimbal ring (child of outer): rotates about file Z (Blender Y)

R4M_Gyroscope_Rotor.role: flywheel rotor (child of inner): spins about its axle, file Y at rest

notes: Runtime placeholder ring is d 0.598 (outside the 0.55 cell); the visual gimbal keeps every part inside the cell.
